skills.title: Stand and recover
skills.summary: Keep standing while being pushed, stepping if it must.
skills.detail: The quickest skill to learn and the best first lesson. Robots are pushed from every side and learn to catch themselves with hips, knees and steps.

skills.title: Walk
skills.summary: Walk forward, backward, sideways and turn at the speed asked.
skills.detail: What humanoid teams train first: the robot follows a speed command, as from a joystick, with a gait clock that swings each leg in turn. On a laptop GPU it takes around an hour.

skills.title: Walk and run
skills.summary: Walk, run, side-step and turn at the speed asked, in any direction.
skills.detail: One policy for moving around: as the commanded speed rises past 0.5 m/s the gait clock shortens the stride and the time each foot is down, until above 1 m/s both feet leave the floor between steps, which is running. Top speeds open up as the robot learns. On a laptop GPU it takes two to three hours.

skills.title: Jump
skills.summary: Jump on command and land standing.
skills.detail: The robot stands until a jump is asked for, then crouches, springs off both feet, and lands back on its feet and its shock absorbers. Practice asks for a jump every few seconds. On a laptop GPU it takes about an hour.

rewards.label: Stay up
rewards.help: Points for every moment it has not fallen.

rewards.label: Walk at the speed asked
rewards.help: Points for moving forward and sideways at the commanded speed.

rewards.label: Turn at the rate asked
rewards.help: Points for turning at the commanded rate.

rewards.label: Step in rhythm
rewards.help: Points when each foot is down or up as the gait clock says.

rewards.label: Keep the body's lean
rewards.help: Penalty for the body tilting away from its standing lean.

rewards.label: Keep the hips high
rewards.help: Penalty for the hips sagging below standing height.

rewards.label: No bouncing
rewards.help: Penalty for the body moving up and down.

rewards.label: No rocking
rewards.help: Penalty for the body rolling or pitching.

rewards.label: Stay in place
rewards.help: Penalty for drifting across the floor.

rewards.label: Stay near the standing pose
rewards.help: Penalty for joints far from standing.

rewards.label: Keep the legs straight ahead
rewards.help: Penalty for hips turning or splaying sideways.

rewards.label: Keep the upper body still
rewards.help: Penalty for the waist turning.

rewards.label: Lift the feet
rewards.help: Penalty for a swinging foot far from the lift height: no shuffling.

rewards.label: No sliding feet
rewards.help: Penalty for a foot moving while it is down.

rewards.label: Move smoothly
rewards.help: Penalty for actions changing quickly: no jitter.

rewards.label: Gentle joints
rewards.help: Penalty for joints speeding up or slowing hard.

rewards.label: Unhurried joints
rewards.help: Penalty for fast joints.

rewards.label: Save effort
rewards.help: Penalty for motor torque as a share of each motor's peak.

rewards.label: Save energy
rewards.help: Penalty for mechanical power: battery life.

rewards.label: Keep clear of joint limits
rewards.help: Penalty for joints beyond 90% of their range.

rewards.label: Land softly
rewards.help: Penalty for a foot striking the floor harder than 1.3 times the robot's weight.

rewards.label: Keep the shocks off their stops
rewards.help: Penalty for a shock absorber at the end of its stroke.

rewards.label: Spring up
rewards.help: Points for rising fast as a jump takes off.

rewards.label: Leave the floor
rewards.help: Points for both feet in the air in the middle of a jump.

rewards.label: Jump high
rewards.help: Points for the hips rising above standing height in the middle of a jump.

rewards.label: Stay down between jumps
rewards.help: Penalty for a foot leaving the floor when no jump is asked.

rewards.label: Falling
rewards.help: Penalty for each fall, in points per fall.
